step1_analysis.description: A PMOS-based Gilbert cell used as an analog tap multiplier in a Decision-Feedback Equalizer (DFE). It multiplies a differential analog tap weight (VIN_P/N) by a differential digital decision (DI/DI_BAR) to produce a differential output current (IOUT_P/N) that is summed at the DFE summing node.

paper_reference.title: An Adaptive Analog Noise-Predictive Decision-Feedback Equalizer

power.description: Total DC power consumption of the multiplier cell.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Calculated based on the tail current source bias and SKY130 PMOS parameters. This is a single sub-block, so power is a small fraction of the total 130 mW.

gm.description: Transconductance from analog input to differential output current.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Based on differential pair small-signal parameters. Determines the tap weight scaling factor.

delay.description: Switching delay from digital decision input to output current zero-crossing.

sky130_expected.calculation: Determined by load RC time constant and switch transistor transit time. With 1k ohm load and ~50fF parasitic capacitance, tau = 50ps.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Must be significantly less than 1 UI (1.25 ns) to meet DFE feedback timing constraints.

sky130_expected.calculation: Limited by the tail current, which is approximately 38 uA.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The entire tail current is steered to one side when fully switched by the digital decision.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure DC power, transconductance (Gm) via DC sweep, and switching delay via transient analysis.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Testbench for DFE Tap Multiplier
.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u

* DUT
XM1 N_L VIN_P N_TAIL VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N_R VIN_N N_TAIL VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 IOUT_P DI_BAR N_L VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 IOUT_P DI N_R VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 N_TAIL VBB VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 IOUT_N DI_BAR N_R VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM7 IOUT_N DI N_L VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}

* Loads (to convert current to voltage for measurement)
RL1 IOUT_P 0 1k
RL2 IOUT_N 0 1k

* Sources
VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VVBB VBB 0 0.99

* Analog Inputs (Tap Weight)
VVIN_CM VIN_CM 0 0.9
E_VIN_P VIN_P VIN_CM VIN_DIFF 0 0.5
E_VIN_N VIN_N VIN_CM VIN_DIFF 0 -0.5
VVIN_DIFF VIN_DIFF 0 DC 0.2

* Digital Inputs (Decision)
* DC values are used during DC sweep, PULSE is used during Tran
VDI DI 0 DC 0 PULSE(0 1.8 0 50p 50p 1n 2n)
VDI_BAR DI_BAR 0 DC 1.8 PULSE(1.8 0 0 50p 50p 1n 2n)

.lib "${SKY130_PDK}/models/sky130.lib.spice" tt

.control
  * 1. Operating Point & Power
  op
  let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
  print power
  
  * 2. DC Sweep for Gm
  * Sweeps analog input while digital decision is held constant (DI=0, DI_BAR=1.8)
  dc VVIN_DIFF -0.5 0.5 0.01
  let iout_diff = (v(IOUT_P) - v(IOUT_N)) / 1k
  let gm_array = deriv(iout_diff)
  meas dc gm_max max gm_array
  meas dc gm_0 find gm_array at=0
  
  * 3. Transient for Delay and Output Swing
  * Pulses digital decision while analog input is held constant (VIN_DIFF=0.2V)
  tran 10p 4n
  let vout_diff = v(IOUT_P) - v(IOUT_N)
  let iout_diff_tran = vout_diff / 1k
  
  * Measure switching delay
  meas tran delay_rise trig v(DI) val=0.9 rise=1 targ vout_diff val=0 fall=1
  meas tran delay_fall trig v(DI) val=0.9 fall=1 targ vout_diff val=0 rise=1
  
  * Measure output current swing
  meas tran iout_diff_max max iout_diff_tran
  meas tran iout_diff_min min iout_diff_tran
  
  quit
.endc
.end
